Subject: Private hosting: implementation deep-dive scheduling

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the productive discovery session earlier today. The team at Orchid is excited about Redwood’s Private deployment option and we want to keep momentum on the implementation side.

Ask: can we schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review / technical deep dive next week so our network and security folks can validate the VPC connectivity and deployment model? Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed May 5, 2027 — 10:00–11:30 AM
- Thu May 6, 2027 — 9:00–10:30 AM

Attendees from Orchid: myself (product), Tom Baker (IT/network lead), plus our security engineer (TBD). From your side, could Karthik lead the technical run-through and someone from the ops/implementation team join?

Pre-call items we can share on our side: brief network diagram and current outbound IP ranges. I’ve attached a draft network diagram for context. Also, can you share a one-page checklist of any run-of-show items Redwood expects for a Private/VPC kickstart?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

--
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product
Orchid Health
Attachment: orchid_network_diagram.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Alicia — great to meet earlier, thanks for sharing the diagram.

Karthik (cc’d) will lead the architecture deep dive; Rishi will join on the ops/implementation side to talk provisioning and timelines. Both requested the following from Orchid, ideally before the call:
- VPC CIDR ranges and NAT/bastion patterns
- Expected token/data residency constraints (S3 buckets, logging endpoints)
- If you have an internal contact for your security engineer, please share so we can include them on the invite

We’re available for the two windows you proposed. Karthik prefers Wed May 5 at 10:00 AM PST — that works for our internal team. If that slot fits your participants, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

I’m attaching a short internal-runbook link below that we use to structure the call (runbook includes sample agenda, network checklist, and required telemetry access).

Agenda (draft)
- 10m — Introductions & objectives
- 30m — Network/VPC topology and connectivity requirements (Karthik)
- 20m — Ops & provisioning timeline, required credentials (Rishi)
- 15m — Q&A & next steps

Jonas
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference
